the trust boundary is exact and narrower than the claim: the searcher calls the shipped total function rather than re-implementing any clause, the admitter's bytes are pinned, the certificate COPIES the deciding clause rather than deriving it, a repair is an offer that is never applied, and nothing is executed, written or persisted

it reuses substance verified in the code before the design was written: symbol_ledger.decide is pure, total and mutation-free (which is what makes exhaustive ball enumeration a construction rather than a wish); load_inputs already takes census and schema paths as parameters, which is what makes the corruption arms real; and the registered-run refusal pattern exists. it can be defeated before implementation (corpus floors, and a blind-control ceiling that stops the slice at registration) and after (one unsound certificate fails it at zero tolerance)

Carried, now with COORDINATES' transferable finding attached - exhaustiveness is separable from addressing.

imported_lessons: from WITNESS: naming is not consuming. The repair certificate COPIES `refusal_code_before`, `deciding_clause_before` and `also_grounds_for_before` from the admitter's own output and never re-derives them, so a certificate can never claim a clause the admitter did not name.

from SEPARATOR: silence must have its own bucket, and never be phrased as its opposite. The certificate carries three distinct silences - NO_REPAIR_WITHIN_K (the ball was finished and held no admission), EXCLUDED (the line fell outside a frozen bound, decided at R-PRE) and, as the legal (status, minimality) cross-product records, no third way for a row to leave the denominator after the score. None is ever written as 'unrepairable'. NOTE: an earlier version of this entry listed BUDGET_EXHAUSTED as a third silence; the design removed that status when the ball was proved enumerable under the frozen exclusions, and the budget is now a defensive assertion whose breach turns B3 red.

from CEILING LEDGER: a control family's own ceiling must be computed against its voiding threshold and a family that cannot fire is a construction defect, not a pass. B11 does this - but NOT 'at registration', which the design had to correct as circular: B11 predicts the searcher's own label, so the ceiling cannot precede the searcher. The timing is split instead - family, features, tie-break, split, clause-wise class balance, margin, operative bar and the registered enrichment all frozen at R-PRE; ceiling and fitted agreement computed at R-P1 the moment labels exist and strictly before B3's aggregate is read. The wider per-gate audit parks behind its held-out-defect prerequisite.
from SEEP: a containment sweep must cover the COMMITTED tree, not the run's outputs. B8 does, and names this design document itself as in scope - which is why the design quotes no corpus value.

from MUTANTS: an attack that is a description is not an attack. B12 requires every containment mutant to be a program that performs the attempt and returns what happened, scored by whether the value landed and never by whether a detector fired, with a machine-readable detector id in the seal rather than a prose sentence a later runner interprets.
grounding_corrections_made_at_step_5: no machine-stranger provisioning script exists in this repository; the design does not claim one. It names the digest-pinned local model that DOES exist (scripts/machine_reader.py, weights blob SHA-256 pinned, verify_weights refuses rather than downloads) and registers drawing the corpus as an R-PRE construction step.

machine_reader's own manifest records that no seed field exists anywhere in this tree, so temperature-0 determinism has never been tested here. The design turns that into a STOP - the corpus seal requires two byte-identical decode passes - rather than a caveat.

the outside series assumed a repair surface with no prior art. Two pieces of adjacent prior art were found and are disclosed in §1.1 rather than discovered by review: retrieval.ClarificationRequest.suggested_key (which proposes a store key for a MISSING datum and is asserted equal to the unresolved literal, so it never edits the person's input), and the only edit-distance code in the tree, which is a blind control inside experiments/ and on no serving path.

the design's ball arithmetic is stated over the ACTUAL alphabet and enum: nine syntactic categories in schema/equation-node.schema.json, five reserved prefixes, 286 census equality members, SYMBOL_CAP 4, and the committed name production ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$. k_max is 2 and a per-line ball budget is frozen, because a cost-3 name ball is not enumerable at this alphabet size.

the sum_total prefix-capture hazard flagged at v0.25 was fixed at HEAD by DISCLOSURE, not refusal - the parser still truncates and now records a parse_rewrites row, because 17 committed templates depend on the rule. The design says so where it matters (SEPARATOR's pre-gate) and does not describe it as refused.

post_review.verdict_on_first_draft: REWORK - an independent adversarial review returned 1 Critical, 9 High, 6 Medium and 3 Low, every finding checked against the code and two demonstrated by execution.
the_three_structural_ones: C-1: B8's containment sweep could not pass. A line refused COLLIDES_WITH_LIBRARY_SYMBOL is refused precisely because its name is a member of experiments/symbol_census.json, so a sweep forbidding stranger-drawn names anywhere in the committed tree goes red on the exact refusal class the algebra was extended to serve. B8 now carries frozen carve-outs (census members, schema enum, reserved prefixes, the algebra's own vocabulary) and is scoped to whole lines plus non-census names.

H-1: the capability-blind control was a strict subset of the searcher's own ball - every constant edit is a cost-1 point an exhaustive searcher already reaches - so the voiding sentence was monotone by construction and could fire only on an exact tie. That is the v0.25 B9 defect rebuilt inside the gate advertised as its remedy. B11 is now a surface-only LABEL predictor that never searches, with a family-ceiling check whose timing the design then had to correct again (see self_caught_after_the_rework); the constant-edit family is demoted to B11b, a triviality STOP, and is not called a control.

H-2: B7 was false against the shipped decide, shown by running it - decide selects by min(held, key=REFUSAL_CODES.index) and REFUSAL_CODES derives from CLAUSE_ORDER, so a clause transposition moves refusal_code_before and cert_id too, not only deciding_clause_before.
post_review.also_fixed: H-3 (the impossible 'shares no imports' claim, and B5's shared-misreading risk, now priced arithmetically via ball_size_by_op); H-4 (the cost-1 formula omitted category_delete, counted self-substitution, and indexed categories by arity); H-5 (an unbounded arity codomain and no bound on category-token count left the ball infinite on a line the grammar accepts; BUDGET_EXHAUSTED was unreachable); H-6 (the algebra is undefined on UNPARSED lines and clauses c6/c7/c8 cannot fire on a standalone line at all, so the reach is exactly c2-c5); H-7 (no floor on the scored denominator and no de-duplication rule for a temperature-0 generator); H-8 and H-9 as above and below; M-1 through M-6 and L-1 through L-3.
post_review.H-9_the_missing_trusted_component: machine_reader.ask cannot write a declaration line - it is hard-wired to forced-choice grading with max_tokens 4 and a single-capital-letter system prompt - and the program that would author the ENTIRE scored population was unnamed and absent from the trusted-components section. scripts/draw_repair_corpus.py is now named in §4 and R-PRE, and §5's present tense was moved to the future conditional.
post_review.the_design_caught_one_on_itself: before the review returned, the design's own B8 rule was run against the design: §1's worked examples were three SEALED FIXTURE VALUES (an admitted symbol, a refused symbol and a bogus category), which is the 2026-09-02 grammar-example finding's own vector. Replaced with placeholders verified absent from the fixture corpus, the census, the schema enum, the served grammar rows and their generated echoes.
post_review.review_finds_kept: the containment carve-out reasoning, the exhaustive-searcher-dominates-its-own-subset argument, and the arithmetic blind spot in a two-program re-enumeration are all recorded in the design itself (§7 B5, §7.1, §11) rather than only in this receipt, because each is a general lesson about instruments and not a fact about this slice.
post_review.self_caught_after_the_rework: One more, found by the design's own author against the reworked text and before the second review returned: B11's replacement control predicts the SEARCHER'S OWN LABEL, so its family ceiling cannot be computed 'at registration, before any searcher output exists' - that would be circular. The first draft's control could be checked at registration only because it was a subset of the searcher and therefore measured nothing, which is the same defect wearing the opposite face. §7.1 now splits the timing: the family, features, tie-break, split, clause-wise class balance, margin and the defect-rule are frozen at R-PRE; the ceiling and the fitted agreement are computed at R-P1 the moment labels exist and strictly before B3's aggregate is read, with the runner refusing to emit B3's fraction until the ceiling is recorded. B11b remains a genuine registration-time computation, which is the honest asymmetry between them.
post_review.second_self_catch_the_tie_break: Also found by the author against the reworked text: the design had no tie-break for equal-cost repairs. Measured against the shipped admitter and the committed census, a name colliding with a library symbol admits on the order of 200-400 distinct cost-1 name edits (measured over all 286 name-shaped census members: min 57, median 234, mean 320.5, max 1329), so 'the least-cost repair' was selector freedom on two of the four reachable clauses. §3.1 now freezes a total order on the ball (operation order, then position, then target token in the declared alphabet order) so a certificate is a deterministic function of the line and the algebra, and every certificate carries `tie_count` with R-R2 publishing its distribution. The same measurement makes B11b's triviality stop the most likely outcome of the slice, and the design says so rather than discovering it after a run.
post_review.third_self_catch_a_failing_test_not_a_re: The design's §3.2 illustrated the admitter's silent casefolding using the CAPITALIZED spelling of a sealed admitted fixture symbol, on the wrong assumption that a different capitalization is a different string. run_house_rules_gates._sweep_tree_for_names casefolds the tree before matching, so the shipped B5 whole-repository disclosure classified docs/DESIGN-repairable-refusal.md as `added_after_the_seal_and_unclassified` and tests.test_house_rules_run's test_every_disclosed_path_is_classified_by_the_published_rule went RED. This was a failing test in the repository, not a reviewer's note - the previous cycle's instrument caught this cycle's design document. Fixed with a non-sealed placeholder; B8 now states in writing that its sweep casefolds and that a re-spelling is not an escape; the suite is green again (132 tests).
post_review.fourth_self_catch_b11_degeneracy_and_ord: Two more closed against the reworked text. First, the ordering claim was doing more work than it can: the runner's refusal to emit B3 before the ceiling is discipline in the runner's own code, so the design now states that the SUBSTANTIVE protection is the R-PRE freeze of family, features, tie-break, split and margin - nothing that voids the capability can be chosen after seeing a number - and that the ordering protects the author's reasoning, not the arithmetic. Second, v0.25's B9 fitted rule predicted one class for every scored row, so its agreement equalled the majority-class rate by arithmetic rather than by signal; B11 now requires the fitted rule's predicted-class distribution on the scored half to be published beside the agreement, and a one-class rule is reported as degenerate with its agreement read as evidence in neither direction.

second_review.verdict: REWORK again - one Critical and six High against the REWORKED text, plus eight Medium and four Low, all taken.
second_review.its_critical_was_introduced_by_the_first: B3, the headline gate, had been rewritten as `max(0.60, B11's derived floor)` while B11 was being replaced wholesale. B11 sets a threshold on a CONTROL'S AGREEMENT and defines no yield floor at all, and the phrase 'derived floor' occurs exactly once in the document - in that line - while §3.1 called the undefined term the BINDING one. The slice's pass condition, on which R-R1's licensed sentence depends, was preregistered against a symbol nothing defines. B3 is now a flat frozen 0.60.
second_review.the_derivation_that_ran_backwards: The scorable floor of 40 was claimed as DERIVED from B11's ten-point margin and instead made the cited failure worse. What decides whether a control can fire is rows-above-majority: for a strict k/n > m/n + 0.10, a 19-row half fires at m+2 (operative bar 10.53 points) but a 20-row half fires at m+3 (15 points), because any multiple of ten pushes the strict inequality onto the next grid point. The floor is now 38, and R-PRE computes the operative bar from n and adjusts under a frozen rule if it exceeds 12 points, publishing it beside the nominal ten.
second_review.the_command_word: `decide` reads the line MINUS the command word, so §1's opening assertion was false against the shipped code, the algebra was defined over a string parse_declaration cannot parse, no component stripped the word, and B2's contamination arm compared stripped lines against `declare`-prefixed strings and could never fire. Both forms are now stored, the strip is frozen in the algebra file and owned by draw_repair_corpus.py, and B2 compares served-against-served.
second_review.the_measurement_that_was_a_filtered_samp: The tie-count figures were described as 'the first six name-shaped members of the census'. They were the first six OF LENGTH THREE TO FIVE - a selection criterion presented as an observation, dropping the genuinely-first three at 57, 151 and 142 - and the design used that sample to predict its own most likely outcome. Replaced with the distribution over all 286.
second_review.also_fixed_2: H-2 (§9's stop condition referenced an enrichment that was never registered - the one stop that fires when the control turns out unfireable licensed widening the family after labels exist; the enrichment is now frozen at R-PRE and capped); H-5 (B8 forbade whole lines and repaired names but not SOURCE names, though the leak it discharges was a leaked name); H-6 (this receipt re-asserted two defects the design had fixed - corrected above); and all twelve Medium and Low findings.
second_review.what_the_second_review_verified_clean: B7's three-move/four-hold split against the shipped decide; the whole ball arithmetic (1813, 225, 8, 2046, 2138, 4,376,394, ~9.8e9) recomputed and confirmed as genuine upper bounds; §3.2's reach derivation including the casefolding paragraph; B5's arithmetic second half; B3's population partition, called airtight; B11's escape from the searcher's ball; every cited API, digest, import list and timing; and 'Status: DESIGN ONLY' as honest, with all seven proposed artifacts verified absent from the tree.
